scope: Developer UI acceptance with controlled mocked API responses. No real model inference or learner outcome evidence.

checks.name: Supported answer links claims to quotes
checks.observed: Two individually numbered claims each display their own exact quote. The second quote opened null-logic and focused the source heading.

checks.name: Insufficient result and source recovery
checks.observed: Displays Selected sources are insufficient without accepted claims; retrieved passage button opened scope.

checks.name: Unverified outcome stays distinct
checks.observed: Displays No answer passed local checks with no accepted claims and accessible retrieved passages.

checks.name: Chinese UI and requests
checks.observed: Request log language=zh; localized outcome, claim, cancellation and disclosure labels; quotes retained original source wording.

checks.name: Keyboard disclosure and quote action
checks.observed: Enter expanded the checks disclosure in English and Chinese; Enter on a quote button selected its source and moved focus to the source heading.

checks.name: Narrow screen
checks.observed: Actual app rendered in a 390px by 844px same-origin iframe; claim, quote card and saved-answer summary visibly wrap within the frame. One actual screenshot retained.

checks.name: Cancel and recover
checks.observed: Initial bug reproduced twice: cancellation resubmitted the form. Root repaired keyed buttons/preventDefault. Rebuilt preview then logged exactly one request followed by cancelled, with no response after the 15-second delay; idle confirmation remained. Next ordinary request succeeded.

checks.name: Edit or leave cancels obsolete request
checks.observed: Editing the query clears busy/result state. Leaving Ask for Notebook cancels its request. Both fixture logs contain one request then cancelled and no response.

checks.name: Saved supported/legacy answers and pagination
checks.observed: Notebook initially showed 10 newest of 18 saved records. Earlier answers revealed the legacy fixture. Supported record retained claim checks; legacy retained Source quotes located and no new support-check claims. Source clicks worked.

checks.name: History available after refresh
checks.observed: Browser refresh followed by reopening Notebook restored all 18 then-saved fixture records without an ask request; fixtures came from the isolated HTTP API, not main storage.

limitations: API/model results are controlled fixtures. Rendering/interaction checks do not establish model answer quality.
The narrow viewport was a same-origin iframe; this is not physical mobile-device verification.
No records were written to the main 4317 server. The fixture server stores synthetic history in memory.
generateCancelReview: Generate controls are outside the Ask form in src/App.tsx; this particular form-submit cancellation defect does not apply.
